assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are organizer-supplied provisional geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All geometry, areas, ratios, figures, schedules and matrices must be recalculated after exact official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: PROV-KEY-003 has a documented Dazhongsi station-anchoring discrepancy in Issue #1029 and is retained without independent relocation.
assumptions.impact: Southern-area content is directional only; station integration and four-quadrant design require full re-anchoring review.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, existing buildings, utilities and engineering constraints are not available as authoritative inputs.
assumptions.impact: Land use, footprints, roads, phasing and retain/renovate/demolish actions are concept references, not statutory or investment commitments.

assumptions.statement: Qinghuayuan Station and related heritage interfaces require protection-zone, archaeological and specialist review before physical intervention.
assumptions.impact: Use reversible interpretation, digital overlays and zero-new-volume principles until heritage review confirms otherwise.

assumptions.statement: The railway, underground high-speed rail, Line 13, bridges, roads and utilities have complex vertical and safety relationships.
assumptions.impact: No bridge, tunnel, crossing or utility alignment in this package is an engineering solution.

assumptions.statement: No-login applies to public ground, basic wayfinding, basic participation, help and a dignified human-readable alternative; it does not waive lawful authentication for R&D, payment or regulated professional services.
assumptions.impact: Every controlled red zone needs a visible threshold and a continuous ordinary-route bypass.

assumptions.statement: Optional AI help uses data minimization, visible session state, expiry by default and human escalation; no face recognition or cross-context durable personal profile is proposed.
assumptions.impact: Operators must prove deletion/expiry and suspend the smart layer without closing the ordinary public service.

assumptions.statement: Named events, operators and funding arrangements are long-term operation concepts rather than confirmed government programs.
assumptions.impact: Each phase needs owner, budget, public review and stop criteria before implementation.
